message.content:
Created [ideas.md](/ideas.md) with four competing explanations, discriminating predictions, concrete follow-up questions, conditional consequences, and explicit evidence limits. It distinguishes observations from hypotheses and does not claim the paper’s reported coarsening as a novel discovery.

Saved the reusable research note at [wave-followup-research-note.md](/memory/wave-followup-research-note.md). It records the evidence constraints and safeguards, including that this is one aggregate trajectory, not 2,199 independent runs, and that the exported uncertainty field is not interpretable as a confidence interval from the supplied information.
